$description: SplitView and ReadingPane (platform/patterns/SplitView; owner, 2026-10-16): two panels sharing their room, side by side or stacked, with a divider between (an 8px gutter with two thin lines and a three-line grip, the whole gap the target), and the reading pane's frame (the data grid's).

split-view-gap.$description: The gap between the panels: the divider's gutter, two thin lines and a grip, the whole gap its target (owner, 2026-10-26: the uiwjs look, 8px on the 4px grid).

split-view-padding.$description: The room all around the split view, so its panels never touch the rest of the screen (owner, 2026-10-27, splitview-design-29: A, 16px on the 4px grid).

split-view-radius.$description: The panels' outer corners, the same on both (owner, 2026-10-27, splitview-design-29: both 6px); the corners at the divider are square.

split-view-second-min-width.$description: Side by side: the second panel never gets narrower than this (under the split view's 900px they stack).

split-view-second-min-height.$description: Stacked: the second panel never gets shorter than this; the divider stops where the second panel would (issue 560).

reading-pane-background.$description: The reading pane's surface (the data grid's).

reading-pane-border-color.$description: The reading pane's frame (the data grid's).

reading-pane-border-width.$description: The reading pane's frame and the actions row's line.

reading-pane-radius.$description: The reading pane's corners (the data grid's).

reading-pane-actions-gap.$description: Between the actions in their row.

reading-pane-actions-padding-block.$description: The actions row's room above and below.

reading-pane-actions-padding-inline.$description: The actions row's room at its ends.

reading-pane-rule-color.$description: The thin line under the actions.

reading-pane-rule-inset.$description: The line under the actions stops this far from each edge (owner: it does not touch the edges).
